method: uniform Python Random.choice over three independently authored whole-scene ideas; no candidate or prior experiment access

options.idea: A xenobiologist freezes on the narrow maintenance landing of a living ship lung as translucent filter-feeders lift from its breathing pools toward her warm lamp.
A living cargo hatch opens into an unfamiliar nursery whose small organisms are nested inside the same vascular hull ribs.
The ship nursery has grown translucent listening sails that bend toward the human whose boots have just disturbed the deck.

selected.idea: The ship nursery has grown translucent listening sails that bend toward the human whose boots have just disturbed the deck.
